fields.name: credential_type
fields.description: Whether the state issues a formal license, a registration, or another credential type to practitioners.
fields.sample_quote: It shall be unlawful for an individual to use the title of "naturopathic doctor" or "doctor of naturopathic medicine" unless that person is registered as a naturopathic doctor with the board.

fields.name: protected_titles
fields.description: Specific titles that are legally protected and may only be used by credentialed practitioners.
fields.sample_quote: It shall be unlawful for an individual to use the title of "naturopathic doctor" or "doctor of naturopathic medicine" unless that person is registered as a naturopathic doctor with the board.

fields.name: prerequisite_bachelor_degree_required
fields.description: Whether a bachelor's degree from an accredited institution is required before entering the naturopathic program.
fields.sample_quote: Have a bachelor's degree from a regionally accredited or preaccredited college or university or the equivalent.

fields.name: naturopathic_program_total_credit_hours
fields.description: Minimum total credit hours required in the naturopathic medical program.
fields.sample_quote: Complete a minimum of 4,100 total credit hours in basic and clinical sciences, naturopathic philosophy, naturopathic modalities and naturopathic medicine.

fields.name: naturopathic_program_academic_instruction_hours
fields.description: Minimum hours of academic (didactic) instruction required within the naturopathic program.
fields.sample_quote: Of the total requisite hours, not less than 2,500 hours shall consist of academic instruction.

fields.name: naturopathic_program_clinical_training_hours
fields.description: Minimum hours of supervised clinical training required within the naturopathic program.
fields.sample_quote: not less than 1,200 hours shall consist of supervised clinical training approved by a naturopathic medical school.

fields.name: cpr_certification_required
fields.description: Whether current CPR certification is required as a condition of licensure or registration.
fields.sample_quote: Be certified to administer cardiopulmonary resuscitation.

fields.name: exam_grandfather_clause
fields.description: Whether practitioners who graduated before a specified cutoff year may substitute a prior state exam for the current national exam requirement.
fields.sample_quote: or has graduated prior to 1986 and has passed a state naturopathic licensing examination.

fields.name: exam_grandfather_cutoff_year
fields.description: The graduation year before which a practitioner may qualify under a grandfather clause and substitute a prior state exam.
fields.sample_quote: or has graduated prior to 1986 and has passed a state naturopathic licensing examination.

fields.name: disciplinary_grounds
fields.description: Enumerated statutory grounds on which the board may impose disciplinary or corrective action against a practitioner.
fields.sample_quote: The board may impose disciplinary or corrective action on a naturopathic doctor for any of the following reasons: Failing to demonstrate the qualifications or standards for a registration contained in this act.

fields.name: mandatory_fitness_examination_authority
fields.description: Whether the board has statutory authority to compel a practitioner to undergo a physical or mental fitness examination upon probable cause.
fields.sample_quote: the board shall, upon probable cause, have authority to compel a practitioner to submit to a mental or physical examination by a physician or a psychologist approved by the board.

fields.name: revocation_reinstatement_waiting_period_years
fields.description: Minimum number of years a practitioner must wait after revocation before applying for reinstatement.
fields.sample_quote: A person whose registration has been revoked may apply for reinstatement, after a period of at least five years, but must meet all of the qualifications under section 202.

fields.name: felony_revocation_reinstatement_waiting_period_years
fields.description: Minimum number of years a practitioner whose registration was revoked due to a felony drug conviction must wait before applying for reinstatement.
fields.sample_quote: may apply for reinstatement after a period of at least 10 years has elapsed from the date of conviction.
